newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states, U.S. differ over a new strike against Iraq. Kuwait has reservations about paying cost of U.S. troops in Kuwait, asks Washington to delay deployment.
- Saudi Arabia to end budget deficit this year. Arab Monetary Fund expects Saudi GDP to grow 6.2 percent this year from 4.2 percent in 1995.
- United Arab Emirates exports 1.18 million barrels of oil per day to Japan, generating $4.2 billion in the first six months.
- Moroccan central bank governor says there are no economic reasons to devalue the dirham.
- Saudi Arabian investment in Tunisian tourism rises to $100 million.
- Kuwaiti businessmen plan to set up a $500 million holding company in Egypt.
